title: Empty-selection restore/removal behavior

conformance.reason: Task 20.1 reuses the already-implemented and pinned-host-verified guarded artwork restoration/removal protocol (the internal ArtworkPublisher.RestoreAsync and the IArtworkImageWriter SaveImage/RemoveImage boundary, implemented in Phase 5 and exercised by the lifecycle drain and the task 14.3 live matrix). The task adds an internal discriminator (NoFittingBadge), an owned-session selection in the coordinator, a lifecycle-fence guard, and a bounded result classification; none of these introduces an unverified Jellyfin 12 platform behaviour, a Sonarr/Radarr API contract, or a first-time ADR-against-host implementability question.

notes: Runtime figures are the authoritative OpenCode server values for each child session; the collect-session-usage.sh wrapper could not talk to this server instance (its CLI reports a V2 health mismatch), so the orchestrator read the same authoritative session objects directly from the running server. No value was estimated. implementation-reviewer and test-quality-reviewer reported cost_usd 0 (the provider's runtime value for those sessions), recorded as-is. No rework rounds: the implementation-reviewer approved attempt 1 with no open findings, and the test-quality-reviewer's open findings are LOW/INFORMATIONAL (unproven mappings, fence variants, and the absent-baseline direct publisher test assigned to task 20.2; the architecture-09 removal-reachability wording assigned to 20.3).
